messages:
jamal: Heads-up — payroll issue for Heike Müller (employee ID 54321). FEIE/foreign-earned-income flag was applied incorrectly and a foreign bonus appears to have been taxed twice; payroll exported pre-conversion contractor payouts as employee wages. Need off-cycle correction + assess whether a W-2c is required before year-end.

sara-payroll: Can you drop the payrun id, dates, and any supporting screenshots? I'll pull the ledger and run a quick YTD audit.

alex-hr: Heike converted from contractor -> employee on 2025-06-12. Contractor payments Jan–May should have been 1099. HRIS export shows those payments with an employee wage flag — looks like mapping error during the June import.

maria-finance: If the YTD taxable wages include the contractor period, we'll need to correct taxable wages and federal/state withholdings. That likely triggers a W-2c. Looping in our payroll vendor/tax counsel ASAP.

sara-payroll: Payrun id is PR-2025-11-328 (posted 2025-11-30). Quick reconcile shows duplicate federal withholding of $1,523.40 and state withholding of $210.72.

sara-payroll: Running the off-cycle adjustment I usually use: 
```
offcycle_adjust --employee 54321 --payrun PR-2025-11-328 --type ytd-tax-correction --amount -1523.40 --code FEIE-MISCLASS
```

payroll-bot: Off-cycle request queued: OR-2412349999. Status: pending manual review. ETA ~2 business days.

alex-hr: FYI Heike consented to corrections in principle but wants to review the explanation before any W-2c is filed. Please capture the employee acknowledgement.

maria-finance: I'll open a vendor ticket with ADP: ADP-78654 and loop our tax advisor (KPMG / Laura T.). Targeting reconciliation and decision by 2025-12-20 to avoid year-end filing surprises.

jamal: Good plan. If net reimbursements or additional tax credits are needed post-correction, let me know; I can approve off-cycle net adjustments.

sara-payroll: Update: ADP ticket created, attaching ledger exports and HRIS mapping. payroll-bot responded with a validation error on the first attempt (mapping mismatch) — re-sent.

payroll-bot: Ticket ADP-78654 updated by maria-finance at 2025-12-01T09:12Z.

sara-payroll: Audit summary: Jan–May grouped as 'employee' in the HRIS CSV import. I reverted those import flags locally and prepared reversal entries; estimate final gross correction = -20,450.00, federal tax correction = -1,523.40, state = -210.72. Preparing off-cycle payroll for approval.

jamal: Thanks. Keep this thread as the single source of truth and tag me if vendor needs authorization to file a W-2c.

sara-payroll: Will do. I’ll post the signed employee acknowledgement and the off-cycle confirmation once complete. :eyes:

maria-finance: Noted — I'll coordinate the finance sign-off and tax counsel sign-off today.

jamal: Appreciate it.
